entries.name: Defeating the Training-Inference Mismatch via FP16 (Qi et al., 2025)

finding.value: BF16 rounding error breaks consistency between the trainer and the rollout engine in RL fine-tuning; reverting to FP16 effectively eliminates the mismatch
finding.note: Abstract read 2026-10-07. Kept reported (brief 02 §4.7 REPORTED via search; storyboards rule it reported): the paper's own claim, not independently replicated.

compute_savings_vs_rl.value: about an order of magnitude or more
compute_savings_vs_rl.note: Blog (Kevin Lu and Thinking Machines Lab, 2025-10-27), read 2026-10-07: 9x cost reduction with an existing SFT dataset (closer to 18x in GPU-hours), about 30x including teacher sampling, and 50-100x compute efficiency vs RL in a self-distillation experiment. Lab claim, so reported.

popularized_by.note: The blog replicates Qwen3's on-policy distillation result and cites the Qwen3 technical report (brief 02 §4.8 item 3).
